chunks: Aban, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, Maryam (peace be upon her) carried Isa (peace be upon him) for nine hours, each hour [being] a month.
ai.seo_question: How long was Jesus carried in Mary's womb according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the miraculous nature of Prophet Isa’s (peace be upon him) conception and gestation, emphasizing that his time in the womb was compressed into just nine hours, with each hour equivalent to a month. This rapid development underscores the divine power of Allah to create without the usual biological constraints, a theme often cited by Shia scholars to illustrate the unique status of the Imams and Prophets. The narration serves as a testament to the ease of Allah in creation, reinforcing the belief in His absolute sovereignty over time and biology.
